profile.summary: DCM Nouvelle Limited engages in the manufacturing and sale of cotton yarn in in India, Bangladesh, China, Guatemala, Egypt, and internationally. The company offers combed, carded, compact, and double yarns, as well as better cotton initiative, organic, and slub yarns under the FUTURO, PRIMERO, DINERO, and CCY brand names.
